title: Keeping my face and the close framing
caption: Rejected: the camera widened, the face remained source-like, and an old cuff survived. Selected: the pink reference sheet helped retain a close view, my fuller face, and bare tattooed arms.

title: Replacing the man instead of adding a third actor
caption: Rejected: my character appeared between the original performers. Selected: a manually tracked mask targeted only the man on the left; the woman and fast pan stayed intact. The face is motion-blurred, so likeness is less certain than in a close-up.

title: Repairing a mask that vanished between frames
caption: Rejected: missing masks produced negative-color flashes and surviving source clothes. Selected: filling nine empty masks restored a consistent character and the ducking motion. The selected take is still brighter than the source, with graphics about two frames early.

title: Giving both flag hands back to the right person
caption: Rejected: the raised arm near the man was attributed to the woman. Selected: both flags belong to the man again, with the woman and background preserved.

title: Finding a cut hidden inside a shot
caption: Rejected: the woman and drum kit continued into the solo section. Selected: two separate generations meet at local frame 45, preserving the source cut from a duo to a solo performer.

title: Removing a floating shape from an otherwise useful take
caption: Rejected: a black cloth or limb-like shape appeared behind the man near the left drum toward the end. Selected: that artifact is gone while the woman, glasses handoff, and set remain. Facial expression is more subdued than the source.
